<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>MATRIX — Social Media Intelligence | UP Police</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#F5F6FB;
    --panel:#FFFFFF;
    --panel-2:#F2F3F9;
    --spec-bg:#F8F9FD;
    --border:#E6E8F1;
    --border-2:#D4D8E6;
    --ink:#151A2E;
    --text:#2B3350;
    --text-dim:#5B6485;
    --text-faint:#8891AC;

    --brand:#AD7511;
    --brand-bright:#D69A2D;
    --brand-bg:#FBF1DA;
    --red:#C13B34;    --red-bg:#FDEAE8;
    --amber:#B06A0A;  --amber-bg:#FCEFDA;
    --teal:#178271;   --teal-bg:#E1F5F0;
    --blue:#2F58A6;   --blue-bg:#E8EDFA;
    --dev:#414F78;    --dev-bg:#EEF0F9;

    --shadow-sm:0 1px 3px rgba(20,26,55,0.07);
    --shadow-md:0 10px 26px rgba(20,26,55,0.09);
    --shadow-lg:0 22px 50px rgba(20,26,55,0.14);
    --r-sm:10px; --r-md:16px; --r-lg:22px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth; font-size:16px;}
  body{
    margin:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  h1,h2,h3{margin:0; font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;}
  code{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}
  .mono{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}
  ::selection{background:rgba(173,117,17,0.18);}
  .hl{background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 62%, var(--brand-bg) 62%); font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); padding:0 1px;}

  /* ---------- Navbar ---------- */
  nav.navbar{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:80; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.94); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  .nav-inner{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .brand-mark{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;cursor:pointer;}
  .brand-mark .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--red-bg);flex:none;animation:pulse 2.2s infinite;}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:0.4;}}
  .brand-mark .bt{font-weight:800;font-size:1.32rem;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--ink);}
  .brand-mark .bs{display:block;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-top:2px;}
  .nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .nav-home-btn{font-weight:600;font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--text-dim);padding:8px 15px;border-radius:20px;transition:.15s;}
  .nav-home-btn:hover{background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink);}
  .sample-badge{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.04em;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--amber);color:var(--amber);border-radius:20px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--amber-bg);font-weight:600;}

  .ticker{background:var(--panel-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:7px 0;}
  .ticker-track{display:inline-block;animation:scroll-left 38s linear infinite;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .ticker-track b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;}
  .ticker-track span.seg{margin:0 26px;}
  @keyframes scroll-left{from{transform:translateX(0);}to{transform:translateX(-50%);}}

  main{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;}
  .page{display:block; page-break-after:always; margin-bottom:50px; padding-bottom:30px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  nav.navbar, .ticker, .crumb-bar, .prevnext, .disclaimer, .back-link { display: none !important; }

  /* ---------- Box Placement & Print Page-Break Rules ---------- */
  .card, .kpi-card, .chart-card, .mod-card, .table-card, .ladder, .lad-row,
  .cluster-card, .report-card, .module-blurb, .note, details.dl, .bar-row,
  table, tr, tbody, thead, .post-card, .tile, .tiles, .tag-cloud,
  .insight, .header, .mod-header, .scope-row,
  .chart-wrap, .ring-grid, .cluster-grid, .report-grid {
    break-inside: avoid !important;
    page-break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  h1, h2, h3, h4, .section-lbl, .sub {
    break-after: avoid !important;
    page-break-after: avoid !important;
  }

  /* ---------- Homepage hero ---------- */
  .hero{padding:56px 0 30px;}
  .eyebrow{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:var(--brand);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:600;}
  .hero h1{font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem);line-height:1.2;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .hero h1 .en{display:block;font-size:0.44em;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:12px;}
  .hero p.lede{max-width:760px;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:1.06rem;line-height:1.75;margin:18px 0 0;font-weight:400;}
  .scope-row{display:flex;gap:38px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:32px;padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .scope-item .num{font-family:'Poppins';font-weight:800;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--brand);}
  .scope-item .label{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:2px;font-weight:500;}

  .disclaimer{margin:0 0 34px;}
  .disclaimer .box{background:var(--amber-bg);border:1px solid #EAD2A0;border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:15px 18px;font-size:0.9rem;color:#7A5008;line-height:1.65;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:500;}
  .disclaimer .box b{color:var(--ink);}

  .section-lbl{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-faint);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:14px;}

  /* ---------- Module cards ---------- */
  .card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-bottom:60px;}
  .mod-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .mod-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);border-color:var(--accent, var(--brand));}
  .mod-card .mc-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
  .mc-badge{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:13px;background:var(--accent, var(--brand));color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;flex:none;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -4px var(--accent, var(--brand));}
  .mc-icon{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;color:var(--accent,var(--brand));}
  .mod-card h3{font-size:1.14rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.3;}
  .mod-card .mc-en{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-faint);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';margin-top:2px;}
  .mod-card p{font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;margin:0;flex:1;}
  .mc-divider{height:1px;background:var(--border);}
  .mc-stat-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
  .mc-stat .v{font-weight:800;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--ink);}
  .mc-stat .l{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-faint);font-weight:500;margin-top:1px;}
  .mc-cta{font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent,var(--brand));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
  .mc-cta svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .15s;}
  .mod-card:hover .mc-cta svg{transform:translateX(3px);}
  .spark{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;}

  footer{padding:40px 0 70px;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.85;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:20px;}
  footer b{color:var(--text-dim);}

  /* ---------- Module page ---------- */
  .crumb-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 0 0;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}
  .back-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-weight:600;font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--text-dim);padding:8px 4px;}
  .back-link:hover{color:var(--brand);}
  .back-link svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
  .mod-index{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-faint);}

  .mod-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px;padding:22px 0 6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .mod-header .badge-lg{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--accent,var(--brand));color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:1.5rem;flex:none;box-shadow:0 10px 22px -6px var(--accent,var(--brand));}
  .mod-header h1{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.15rem);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.25;}
  .mod-header .mh-en{font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';margin-top:4px;font-weight:500;}

  .module-blurb{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:5px solid var(--accent,var(--brand));border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:20px 24px;margin:22px 0 32px;font-size:0.98rem;line-height:1.85;color:var(--text);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
  .module-blurb .lbl{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent,var(--brand));}

  /* KPI cards */
  .kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(255px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:34px;}
  .kpi-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);border-top:4px solid var(--accent,var(--brand));}
  .kpi-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;}
  .kpi-card .val{font-weight:800;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .kpi-card .lbl{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:6px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;}
  .kpi-card .delta{font-size:0.9rem;margin-top:10px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
  .delta.up{color:var(--red);} .delta.down{color:var(--teal);} .delta.flat{color:var(--text-faint);}

  /* Data logic details/summary toggle — the anti-clutter mechanism */
  details.dl{margin-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border-2);padding-top:0;}
  details.dl summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding-top:12px;font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--dev);user-select:none;}
  details.dl summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  details.dl summary .chev{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .18s;flex:none;}
  details.dl[open] summary .chev{transform:rotate(90deg);}
  details.dl .dl-body{background:var(--spec-bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:14px 16px 16px;margin-top:10px;font-size:0.88rem;}
  .dl-line{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:9px;align-items:flex-start;}
  .dl-line:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .dl-line .k{flex:none;width:108px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.03em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dev);font-weight:700;padding-top:2px;}
  .dl-line .v{flex:1;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.65;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
  .dl-line .v b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600;}
  .chip{display:inline-block;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;background:#fff;color:var(--dev);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:5px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;border:1px solid var(--border-2);white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
  pre.sql{background:#171E30;color:#DCE3EE;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin:10px 0 0;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.75;width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;}

  /* Chart cards */
  .chart-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  @media(max-width:960px){.chart-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .chart-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:22px 22px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);margin-bottom:20px;}
  .chart-card h3{font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:3px;}
  .chart-card .sub{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-faint);margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:500;}
  .chart-card .chart-wrap{height:260px;position:relative;}
  .chart-card .chart-wrap.short{height:210px;}
  .ring-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(112px,1fr));gap:16px;padding:8px 0 2px;}
  .ring-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .ring-lbl{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;text-align:center;}
  .insight{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--brand-bg);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:11px 14px;margin-top:16px;font-size:0.9rem;color:#6B4A0A;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6;}
  .insight svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;margin-top:2px;color:var(--brand);}

  /* Timeline infographic (misinformation) */
  .timeline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin-top:6px;}
  .tl-item{display:flex;gap:16px;padding:14px 0;position:relative;}
  .tl-item:not(:last-child)::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:13px;top:38px;bottom:-4px;width:2px;background:var(--border-2);}
  .tl-dot{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,var(--brand));color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:700;flex:none;z-index:1;}
  .tl-body{flex:1;padding-top:2px;}
  .tl-title{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);font-size:0.95rem;}
  .tl-meta{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:2px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';}
  .tl-reach{font-weight:700;color:var(--accent,var(--brand));font-size:0.95rem;white-space:nowrap;}

  /* Severity ladder infographic (predictive) */
  .ladder{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;}
  .lad-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
  .lad-name{width:90px;flex:none;font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';}
  .lad-track{flex:1;height:14px;background:var(--panel-2);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;}
  .lad-fill{height:100%;border-radius:7px;}
  .lad-count{width:46px;flex:none;text-align:right;font-weight:700;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--ink);}

  table.feed{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;font-size:0.88rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
  table.feed th{text-align:left;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;color:var(--text-dim);padding:12px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel-2);font-weight:600;}
  table.feed td{padding:13px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-dim);vertical-align:top;}
  table.feed tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  table.feed td.strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
  .sev{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;}
  .sev.high{background:var(--red-bg);color:var(--red);}
  .sev.med{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber);}
  .sev.low{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal);}

  .cluster-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .cluster-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:18px 19px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
  .cluster-card .ct-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .cluster-card .ct-name{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;}
  .cluster-card .ct-meta{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7;font-weight:500;}
  .barmeter{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--panel-2);margin-top:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .barmeter i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:3px;}

  .report-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:16px;}
  .report-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
  .report-card .rc-title{font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);}
  .report-card .rc-meta{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;font-weight:500;}
  .report-card .rc-btn{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--brand);border:1px solid var(--brand);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:20px;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--brand-bg);font-weight:600;}

  .note{font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);background:var(--dev-bg);border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:14px 17px;margin-top:18px;line-height:1.75;font-weight:500;}
  .note b{color:var(--ink);}

  .prevnext{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin:44px 0 20px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .pn-btn{flex:1;min-width:220px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:16px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:.15s;}
  .pn-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brand);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
  .pn-btn .pn-lbl{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-faint);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;}
  .pn-btn .pn-title{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-top:4px;font-size:0.98rem;}
  .pn-next{text-align:right;}

  section.mod-section{margin-bottom:6px;}

  @media(max-width:640px){
    .hero{padding:40px 0 22px;}
    .kpi-grid,.card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .dl-line .k{width:96px;font-size:0.9rem;}
  }
</style>
</head>

MATRIX
UP POLICE · SOCIAL MEDIA INTELLIGENCE
← All Modules
Demo · Sample Data
Capability & Data-Logic Demonstration — Not Live Operational Data

Ten Modules. Ten Pages. One Clear Picture.

Built against the supplied up_police_matrix schema. Every module page opens with a plain-language explanation, then shows the KPIs and charts a reviewer would look at — with the developer-facing table/column/SQL logic tucked behind a one-click "Data Logic" toggle on each item, so the screen stays clean until you want the detail.

⚠
All figures, district names, and flagged content are illustrative sample values — meant to show layout, chart style, and reasoning only. No real posts, individuals, officers, or complaints are represented. Table/column references and SQL sketches are grounded in the actual schema you supplied.
Select a module
Back to all modules Module 01 of 10
01

Law & Order — Unrest Early Warning

Detects mobilisation & unrest before it forms
What this module actually does It watches how fast a "story" is spreading on social media compared to that story's own normal pace, and warns an officer before a crowd forms — not after. Every batch of similar posts about the same real event is grouped into one topic. Every few minutes the system counts how many new posts that topic gained in the last 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 minutes (topic_velocity_snapshots) and compares that speed to the topic's own 7-day-average speed (topic_baseline_metrics). If a topic is growing many times faster than its own baseline and is spreading across multiple platforms, the system writes an alert (viral_alerts) with a severity level and pushes it out.
6
Active high-risk zones (district-level)
▲ 2 vs last week
Data Logic
MeaningA district counts here if it has at least one unresolved HIGH or CRITICAL alert tied to a Law & Order topic — i.e. an officer hasn't marked it handled.
Sourceviral_alerts.alert_levelviral_alerts.primary_districtviral_alerts.created_attopic.broad_categorytopic.topic_status
LogicJoin viral_alerts to topic on unique_topic_id. Keep HIGH/CRITICAL rows from the last 24h where the topic's broad_category = 'Law and Order' and topic_status isn't Resolved/Closed. Count DISTINCT primary_district.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT va.primary_district) AS active_high_risk_zones
FROM viral_alerts va
JOIN topic t ON t.unique_topic_id = va.unique_topic_id
WHERE va.alert_level IN ('HIGH','CRITICAL')
  AND va.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND t.broad_category LIKE '%Law and Order%'
  AND (t.topic_status IS NULL OR t.topic_status NOT IN ('Resolved','Closed'));
